title: Mathematical Models of Evolution and Replicator Systems Dynamics
summary: This is an edited English version of the authors' monograph "Mathematical Models of Evolution and Replicator Systems Dynamics", posted on arXiv as a single document to which chapters are added as they are completed; the present version contains Chapters 1-4. The book develops a unified mathematical framework for evolutionary processes in the spirit of generalised Darwinism, built on replicator systems.
